g.text: A window resized by its frame: one size, one frame
The pointer takes the window's frame
and on the page under the pointer (H8)
no position is left to hover:
render(): the tab strip and the status bar
are fitted to the new width
if that changed the chrome: lay_out_now()
(input before the frame must not meet replaced nodes)
begin_paint(): note each page's hovered node
the page's new viewport asks for a redraw
lay out the page at once, then refresh_hover
render, present, wait for the GPU
commit: the buffer of the new size
did a page's hovered node change? no:
the frame answered it, so no other frame
Before L9 (90ad693): two frames for every size
frame A: the chrome still fitted to the old width
and its hover at the pointer's last position
the proxy's Poll: fit to the new width, repaint
frame B: no layout to do, yet a full render and present
